$comment: Vendored from the Agentic Commerce Protocol spec (Apache-2.0), spec/2026-04-17/openapi, commit 7fdd78df677a94dce04c770644b0fbbb1401272b: WebhookEvent and every schema it references. Only $ref paths were rewritten to #/$defs.

type.description: Event type. Implementations MUST accept unrecognized values gracefully. Defined values: 'order_create', 'order_update'. order_create for new orders, order_update for changes to existing orders.

data.description: The order object associated with this event

EventDataOrder.description:
Order data included in webhook events. Uses the full Order schema
from the checkout spec. The 'type' discriminator field is always 'order'.

Order.description:
Order returned after checkout completion. Contains order details and optional
rich post-purchase tracking (line items, fulfillments, adjustments).

type.description: Discriminator field for webhook payloads. Always 'order' when present.

checkout_session_id.description: ID of the checkout session that created this order

order_number.description: Human-readable order number for customer reference

permalink_url.description: Permanent URL where the customer can view order details

status.description: Order-level status. Implementations MUST accept unrecognized values gracefully. Defined values: 'created', 'confirmed', 'manual_review', 'processing', 'shipped', 'completed', 'canceled'. 'completed' means all items have been delivered/received regardless of fulfillment method. Distinct from LineItem.status 'fulfilled', which indicates the seller has dispatched the item.

line_items.description: What was ordered, with per-item fulfillment tracking

fulfillments.description: How items are being delivered (shipping, pickup, digital)

adjustments.description: Post-order changes: refunds, credits, returns, disputes

totals.description: Order-level totals using the same Total schema as checkout. The 'total' entry is always the original charged amount. 'amount_refunded' tracks cumulative refunds.

earliest.description: RFC 3339 timestamp for earliest expected delivery

latest.description: RFC 3339 timestamp for latest expected delivery

EstimatedDelivery.description: Estimated delivery date range for a fulfillment option

confirmation_email_sent.description: Whether a confirmation email has been sent

OrderConfirmation.description: Order confirmation details including order number and tracking information

SupportInfo.description: Customer support contact information including email, phone, and URL

OrderLineItem.description: Per-line-item tracking of what was ordered and fulfillment progress.

id.description: Line item identifier, used for references in fulfillments and adjustments

unit_price.description: Price per unit in minor currency units (cents)

subtotal.description: Line total in minor currency units (quantity.ordered * unit_price)

totals.description: Optional line-item level totals breakdown using the same Total schema as checkout. Merchants who can provide richer breakdowns MAY use this alongside or instead of unit_price/subtotal.

status.description: Derived from quantity fields. Implementations MUST accept unrecognized values gracefully. Defined values: 'processing', 'partial', 'fulfilled', 'removed'. Rules: 'removed' if current==0, 'fulfilled' if fulfilled==current, 'partial' if 0<fulfilled<current, 'processing' otherwise.

OrderLineItemQuantity.description: Quantity tracking for an order line item. Uses a 3-field model: ordered (original), current (active after cancellations/returns), fulfilled (completed).

ordered.description: Quantity originally ordered by the customer

current.description: Current active quantity on the order. May be less than ordered due to cancellations or returns. A value of 0 means the line item has been fully removed.

fulfilled.description: Quantity that has been fulfilled (shipped, picked up, or digitally delivered). Applies to all fulfillment types, not just shipping.

display_text.description: Localized display text for this total

amount.description: Amount in minor currency units (e.g. 100 cents for $1.00 or 100 for ¥100)

presentment_amount.description: Amount in presentment currency minor units if different from settlement currency

description.description: Additional descriptive text for this total

Total.description: Total amounts for the checkout including subtotal, discounts, tax, shipping, and final total

jurisdiction.description: Tax jurisdiction name (e.g., 'California State Tax', 'City of San Francisco')

rate.description: Tax rate as a decimal (e.g., 0.0875 for 8.75%)

amount.description: Tax amount in minor currency units (e.g. 100 cents for $1.00 or 100 for ¥100)

TaxBreakdownItem.description: Breakdown of tax amounts by type, jurisdiction, or rate

Fulfillment.description: A fulfillment represents how items are delivered to the buyer (shipping, pickup, digital).

status.description:
Current fulfillment status. Implementations MUST accept unrecognized values gracefully. Defined values: 'pending', 'processing', 'shipped', 'in_transit', 'out_for_delivery', 'ready_for_pickup', 'delivered', 'failed', 'canceled'. Not all statuses apply to all types:
- shipping: pending, processing, shipped, in_transit, out_for_delivery, delivered, failed, canceled
- pickup: pending, processing, ready_for_pickup, delivered, failed, canceled
- digital: pending, processing, delivered, failed, canceled

line_items.description: Which line items and quantities are in this fulfillment

carrier.description: Carrier name (e.g., 'FedEx', 'UPS', 'USPS'). Applies to type: shipping.

tracking_number.description: Carrier tracking number. Applies to type: shipping.

tracking_url.description: URL to track this shipment. Applies to type: shipping.

digital_delivery.description: Digital delivery details. Applies to type: digital.

access_url.description: URL to access digital content (download link, streaming page, etc.)

events.description: Append-only event log tracking fulfillment progress

LineItemReference.description: Reference to a line item with quantity, used in fulfillments and adjustments

quantity.description: Quantity in this fulfillment or adjustment

Address.description: Physical address for shipping, billing, or pickup locations

FulfillmentEvent.description: A point-in-time event in the fulfillment lifecycle.

type.description: Event type. Implementations MUST accept unrecognized values gracefully. Defined values: 'processing', 'shipped', 'in_transit', 'out_for_delivery', 'ready_for_pickup', 'delivered', 'failed_attempt', 'returned_to_sender', 'canceled', 'undeliverable'. 'out_for_delivery' and 'ready_for_pickup' are ACP extensions for richer agent experiences.

occurred_at.description: RFC 3339 timestamp when this event occurred

location.description: Location where this event occurred (e.g., 'Memphis, TN')

Adjustment.description: A post-order change such as refund, credit, return, or dispute.

type.description: Type of adjustment. Implementations MUST accept unrecognized values gracefully. Defined values: 'refund', 'credit', 'return', 'exchange', 'price_adjustment', 'cancellation', 'dispute'. Use 'refund' for both full and partial refunds (distinguish by amount). 'credit' replaces 'store_credit'. 'dispute' covers chargebacks.

occurred_at.description: RFC 3339 timestamp when this adjustment occurred

status.description: Adjustment status. Implementations MUST accept unrecognized values gracefully. Defined values: 'pending', 'completed', 'failed'.

line_items.description: Which line items and quantities are affected (optional for order-level adjustments)

amount.description: Total amount credited to the buyer in minor currency units, inclusive of any applicable tax
